card.name: Linking words inside dose ranges
card.fires_on: Small linking words or symbols right after a number and unit in dosing text, such as "to", "over", "–" or "hr", where a second quantity or range end is expected.

modes.label: Range linker
modes.description: The word "to" or a dash between two amounts with units, where the second end of the range follows.

modes.label: Duration or rate link
modes.description: "over" or "hr" right after a dose amount, introducing or giving the infusion time.

modes.label: Other list punctuation
modes.description: A bracket or semicolon after a measured value, before a gloss or the next category.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or dash after a dose number that sets up the next number, like the "to" in "2 mCi to 6 mCi".
